_about: V1b = B2 + a guarded head-IMU zero-velocity constraint, cohort 2026c (wiser/scripts/analyze_wiser_v1b.py; plan implementation_plan/2026-10-03-wiser-v1b-zupt.md, approved by the user 2026-10-03 '干吧', step A). Periods, animals, exclusions, IMU seconds and certified still segments are the failure audit's (audit_config / audit_run); S1/S2/S4/S5 definitions are the default-smoother step's (default_smoother_config). B2 = the smoothing pilot's tuned B2 (smoothing_config -> tuned.B2), unchanged. Candidate, sensitivities, thresholds and the decision rule are the plan's and must not be changed after a result. The run writes its verdict into `decision`. A new cohort = a new copy of this file + a re-run.

v1b.base: tuned.B2 of smoothing_config: q 3 in^2/s^3, anchors_used noise table, chi2 gate (13.8155) + 2 Huber IRLS passes (k_H 2.5), forward KF + RTS

release._op: grid_s, roll_min_fix, 'continuously' (an undefined centre ends a stretch) and 'for > 5 s' (span last - first centre > 5 s) are operational choices recorded in the plan's amendment 2 before any V1b number

V1b_raw._note: the original proposal: no erosion, no minimum run, Gaussian, no release

acceptance._rule: V1b passes E1 (E1a calm and rain, E1b both quantiles x both subsets x both sets) and E2 (onset and offset, calm and rain) and E3 -> V1b is the default WISER track for the implanted animals (B2 by construction where the IMU QC fails), B2 the universal baseline; any failure -> B2 stays the default. Point estimates decide; CIs reported. No sensitivity variant is promoted.

bootstrap._note: 10-min animal-period blocks drawn with replacement within each set; paired = the same draw for every method

decision.where: SF07-SF12 wherever the IMU QC passes (V1b is B2 by construction elsewhere)
